items.q: Elon didn't stay with Hamp and I inquired later and Hamp said he was all right

ctx.x: Yes. Elon didn't stay with Hamp and I inquired later and Hamp said he was all right, he just came on back to Tulsa, you know, some of them just don't go for it.
I was always that way about Omaha.
